title: SOC Analyst L1
text:
SOC Analyst L1 - Sample Secure Pvt Ltd, Chennai (24x7 rotational shifts)

What you will do
- Monitor alerts in Splunk and triage them
- Follow incident response playbooks and escalate to L2
- Hunt for threats using MITRE ATT&CK
- Check endpoint alerts in CrowdStrike
- Write shift handover notes

What we need
- 0 to 2 years in a SOC or IT support role
- SIEM basics (Splunk or QRadar)
- Networking basics: TCP/IP, DNS, ports
- Understanding of incident response

Good to have
- Vulnerability assessment with Nessus
- Wireshark

Graduates in CS or IT. Night shift allowance as per policy.
